name: lumina-cinema
description: Lumina Cinema - full-stack movie ticket booking (React + Express + Supabase Postgres)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @lumina/server" "npm run dev -w @lumina/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lumina/client && npm run build -w @lumina/server
